items.title: Requested evidence roles
items.summary: CONFIRMED_STATE requests an established factual state. REPORTED_ACCOUNT requests what reporting says, rather than confirmation of that underlying state. FIRSTHAND_ACCOUNT requests participants' or community accounts themselves. PREDICTION requests a forecast, not a confirmed event. Mentioning or rejecting a role does not request it. Injury, roster, transaction, contract and current status are mutable factual domains, never stable semantic knowledge.

items.title: Native record and analytical relation semantics
items.summary: TEAM_MEMBERSHIP names a team's membership relation for a particular subject, not injury, transactions or a historical event. A current-state endpoint supports only the observation time it actually records. An empty relation target is an answer slot, not an asserted target. A grouped table or separate split values is AGGREGATION; a comparative predicate requires its two operands and relation, and arithmetic requires a replayable operation. These are interpretation definitions, never factual evidence.
